integrity: Exact finite integral unit-pivot certificates and mod-three inclusion checks supplied as self-contained reproducible Python; literature-based full-complex homology distinguished from new finite classification.
limitations: Only degree-two intrinsic torsion of induced subcomplexes of the five-by-five chessboard with at most sixteen vertices; not a homotopy or all-sizes classification. Does not claim minimum ambient cycle support.
title: The unique sixteen-square board with intrinsic \(3\)-torsion in its rook complex
